title: Understanding the Condition
text: To ensure a unique solution in an OLS model, the matrix involved in the calculations must meet a specific condition. Think about the properties of matrices that allow for unique solutions.

title: Matrix Invertibility
text: Consider the role of the matrix $$X^T$$ X in the OLS solution. What does it mean for a matrix to be invertible, and why is this important for finding a unique solution?

title: Matrix Properties
text: What property must the matrix $$X^T$$ X have to ensure it is invertible?
choices: X must not be full column rank.
X must be a square matrix.
X must have fewer rows than columns.
